description: The Tank War fault library (#171) with no GPU, model or game: a stand-in clean release (the stand-in model source and a stand-in fire edit), stand-in trainers, and a recorded round as the teacher batch. It checks that every fault builds from the clean release through Honing's trainers and the Exp 0 v0 builders, and changes only its own cause's part. tests/test_tank_faults.py builds it twice and compares the checksums. The runner, grader and endpoints are built but unused, since there is no gate block. Run: python scripts/e2e/tank_faults.py --config configs/e2e/tank_faults_dry_run.json
